title: VPN Connections
explanation: AWS Site-to-Site VPN creates an encrypted connection between your on-premises network and your AWS VPC over the public internet. It uses IPsec tunnels for secure communication.
analogy: A VPN connection is like a secure, encrypted tunnel through a public highway — your data travels over the internet but is completely hidden from other traffic.
keyPoints: Uses IPsec protocol for encryption over the public internet
Each VPN connection has two tunnels for redundancy
Requires a Virtual Private Gateway (VGW) on the AWS side and a Customer Gateway on-premises
Bandwidth limited to approximately 1.25 Gbps per tunnel

examKeywords.definition: An encrypted IPsec connection between an on-premises network and an AWS VPC, traversing the public internet with two redundant tunnels.

commonMistakes: Not configuring both tunnels for high availability
Choosing VPN over Direct Connect when consistent low-latency is required
